title: Yemen Prison Airstrike Death Toll Rises to 23 as Coalition Strikes Continue
meta_title: Yemen Prison Airstrike Toll Rises to 23 Amid Renewed Strikes
meta_description: The death toll from an airstrike on a Houthi-run prison in northern Yemen has risen to 23, with rescue teams searching for seven people still missing.
discover_titles: Death Toll Rises to 23 Following Airstrike on Houthi-Run Prison in Yemen
Yemen Airstrike Aftermath: 23 Dead and Search Continues for Missing
Deadly Yemen Prison Strike Sparks Cross-Border Escalation and New Attacks
spot: Rescue workers in northern Yemen have recovered additional bodies from the rubble of a Houthi-run detention facility following a Saudi-led coalition airstrike, raising the confirmed death toll to 23 as cross-border hostilities escalate.
content_html:
Key Developments

Search and rescue teams recovered four more bodies from the ruins of a Houthi-administered prison in Yemen's northern Jawf province, raising the total number of dead to 23, rebel officials confirmed. The detention center collapsed earlier in the week after being struck during a Saudi-led coalition assault aimed at the strategic city of Hazm.

Hassan Saboula, director of the civil defense agency in Jawf, stated on the al-Masirah news channel that a child was among the victims recovered from the site. Rescue personnel continue to comb through the wreckage in search of seven individuals who remain missing. Authorities noted that the identities of the deceased have yet to be established.

The bombardment also injured at least seven people, including a woman who was visiting her imprisoned husband at the time of the blast, according to Anees al-Asbahi, a spokesman for the Houthi-run health ministry.

The deadly prison collapse triggered swift retaliation from the Houthis, who launched a coordinated barrage of drones and missiles into southern Saudi Arabia, wounding 73 people. In response, coalition aircraft resumed strikes early Wednesday, hitting several Houthi military installations located across the provinces of Marib and Jawf.

Key Takeaways

  • Casualty Count: At least 23 people, including a child, have been confirmed dead, while seven individuals remain unaccounted for and seven others are injured.
  • Cross-Border Retaliation: Houthi forces answered the Hazm strike with missile and drone operations targeting southern Saudi Arabia, leaving 73 people wounded.
  • Escalating Combat: The coalition initiated a fresh wave of aerial bombardments against Houthi military targets across Jawf and Marib.

Why It Matters

The exchange marks a sharp escalation in renewed combat between the Saudi-led coalition and the Iranian-backed Houthis. Friction between both sides intensified sharply in July after the Houthis attempted to operate an unauthorized flight from Tehran to Yemen's capital, Sanaa, directly challenging a decade-long air and naval blockade imposed by the coalition.

The long-running war began in 2014 when Houthi forces seized Sanaa, forcing the internationally recognized government into exile in Saudi Arabia. The intervention by the Saudi-led coalition the following year escalated the crisis into a conflict that has claimed more than 150,000 lives, according to United Nations estimates, and repeatedly driven the country to the brink of widespread famine.
